A

LISTENING (2.0 POINTS)

Listen to the audio above and complete the exercises below.

I. Listen and choose the best answer A, B or C (Questions 1–5)

1. What is the conversation about?

2. What did the students do last weekend?

3. Where did they donate clothes?

4. What did they plant?

5. Who did they teach English to?

II. Listen and tick True (T) or False (F) (Questions 6–10)

6. Students picked up litter around their school last weekend.
7. They donated books to homeless children.
8. They planted vegetables in the school garden.
9. They taught math last summer.
10. Community service helps people in need.
B

VOCABULARY AND GRAMMAR (3.0 POINTS)

Test your knowledge on vocabulary, grammar rules, and word forms.

I. Choose the best answer (Questions 11–20)

11. Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently:

12. Choose the word that has a different stress pattern:

13. We ______ litter around the school last weekend.

14. They ______ books to a nursing home.

15. She ______ English to homeless children last summer.

16. We ______ vegetables in the garden yesterday.

17. He ______ old people last week.

18. They ______ plastic bottles for recycling.

19. Community service helps ______ people.

20. We work ______ groups in class.

II. Find the Error: Choose the underlined part that needs correction (Questions 21–22)

21. They didn't picked up litter around our school yesterday.

22. She teach English last summer to homeless children.

III. Verb forms: Write the correct form of the verbs in brackets (Questions 23–25)

23. We (pick up) litter around our school last Sunday.
24. They (donate) clothes and books to old people last week.
25. I (help) homeless children learn English last year.
C

READING COMPREHENSION (2.4 POINTS)

Read the descriptions, passages, and choose the correct answer.

I. Look at the description and choose (Question 26)

Description: Students cleaning their school garden, picking up dry leaves and paper.

26. What activity does this description represent?

II. Fill in the blanks with correct options (Questions 27–31)

Last weekend, our class did community service. We (27) ______ litter around the school. We also (28) ______ vegetables in the school garden. After that, we (29) ______ books and clothes to a nursing home. Some students helped (30) ______ English to children. It was a very meaningful activity because we helped many (31) ______ people.
Question (27)
Question (28)
Question (29)
Question (30)
Question (31)

III. Read the passage and choose the correct answer (Questions 32–37)

"Community service is very important for society. Many students join activities such as picking up litter, planting trees, and donating clothes. Last summer, a group of students taught English to homeless children. They also helped old people in a nursing home. They felt happy and useful. Community service also helps improve the environment and brings people together. Students learn how to care for others and work in groups."

32. What is the best title for this passage?

33. What did students do last summer?

34. Who did they help?

35. What does the word "They" (They felt happy and useful) refer to?

36. What activity is NOT mentioned in the text?

37. Why is community service important?

D

WRITING (2.6 POINTS)

Quick interactive exercises. Simply tap words to arrange or fill in small blanks.

I. Arrange words: Click on words to arrange them into correct sentences (Questions 38–40)

38. Arrange: / picked up / we / litter /

39. Arrange: / they / donated / books /

40. Arrange: / did / you / help / people / ? /

II. Rewrite sentences: Complete the second sentence so it means the same as the first (Questions 41–45)

41. I help old people. (Change to past simple)

→ I helped

42. They donate clothes. (Change to past simple)

→ They donated

43. We pick up litter. (Change to past simple)

→ We picked

44. She teaches English. (Change to past simple)

→ She taught

45. I like helping people. (Use "enjoy")

→ I enjoy

III. Applied Quick Practice: Choose the best response for each scenario (Questions 46–48)

46. Teacher: "What did you do for community service last summer?" - Student:

47. Your friend: "Why is community service important?" - You:

48. A student wants to protect the school environment. What should they do?

Xem lại đáp án chi tiết / Answer Key & Explanations

Mini Review: Trọng tâm bài học (Unit 3)

Vocabulary (Từ vựng)
  • community service: dịch vụ cộng đồng 🔊
  • nursing home: viện dưỡng lão 🔊
  • homeless children: trẻ em vô gia cư 🔊
  • donate: hiến tặng, đóng góp 🔊
Grammar Key (Ngữ pháp)
  • Thì Quá khứ đơn (Past Simple) để nói về sự kiện đã kết thúc trong quá khứ.
  • Động từ có quy tắc: picked, planted, donated.
  • Động từ bất quy tắc: taught, helped (help là có quy tắc: helped).
